gen-fs-styro-gf-golos-text: Golos Text reads tall and friendly, its lowercase filling the line with one stroke width and an s that opens wide. Styro crowds its letters tight; the body lets the air back in.
gen-fs-styro-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Hedvig Letters Sans reads friendly and upright, its c left wide open and its small letters nearly as tall as capitals. Styro, tight and closed, makes that openness feel wider by comparison.
gen-fs-styro-gf-heebo: Heebo stands tall in the middle of the line, curves stopping short. Styro, retro and commanding, packs its letters shut, and Heebo's curves open out like a release after it.
gen-fs-styro-gf-hind-guntur: Hind Guntur is sans-serif with wide gaps between curve ends and stems and no thick-thin shift, like a steel cable outline. Styro packs its letters shut right beside that openness.
gen-fs-styro-gf-hind-madurai: Hind Madurai opens its s curves wide at both ends and lets lowercase fill the line almost like capitals. Hind Madurai gives the tight, closed Styro heading room to breathe.
gen-fs-styro-gf-hind-mysuru: Contemporary and plain, Hind Mysuru gives curves and stems matching weight. Styro does retro command best, packed tight, while Hind Mysuru does quiet text best, its lowercase reaching near ascender height.
gen-fs-styro-gf-hind-siliguri: Here the text hums in a flat gray, its rounds gapped like a cracked bangle. Hind Siliguri draws true monoline for steady reading, while Styro spends its crowded, commanding punch on display.
gen-fs-styro-gf-hind-vadodara: Clean and spacious: Styro packs its retro letters tight, while the body opens every curve. Hind Vadodara's uniform strokes and tall-bowled e and a keep a long stretch of text feeling spacious.
gen-fs-styro-gf-huninn: Letters pressed almost shut, with barely a gap in e or c, give Styro its crowded, retro punch. Huninn then steps in with a steady line weight and lowercase rising near cap height.
gen-fs-styro-gf-inter-tight: Inter Tight draws its lines like bent tubing, with short ascenders and curve tails held well back. Inter Tight's signage-like plainness leaves Styro free to do all the commanding.
